subject: [hw] DEC02 -> V40/DEC04: exact staged window text + measured need (6180/19653 ops); larb writes happen at +0x00c
body:
My harness needs VDEC_ALL exactly as DEC04/DEC07 describe; until the frozen header rev 3 and V40 land it stages this on a /tmp copy (tools/stage.py, exact-text matched).  The staged change to vcu/n2vcu.c is one line inserted after the VDEC_SYS entry:

	{ 0x16000000u, 0x30000u, 12u },   /* DEC02 staged: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, DEC04/DEC07 */

Measured with it (T02 fake + n2tr, 12-AU 320x240 and 6-AU 1080p):
- 6180/19653 ops on 320x240 reach only window 12; the other 13473 are still served by the ten frozen entries (first match wins, so putting the new entry last preserves them).  1080p: 3076/9761.
- No access outside 0x16000000..0x1602ffff; the window needs 0x30000, not 0x40000.
- The vendor WRITES larb5 0x1600d00c and larb4 0x1602e00c (SLP_CON bit0=1, then bit0=0; polls bit16).  18 writes each over the 12-AU session.  DEC07 rev 3 refuses larb4 0x2e00c (only allows larb5 0x00c) - DEC04 already flagged this; the measurement confirms it: CORE decode cannot start without the larb4 SLP_CON write.  Please make the allow-list {larb5 +0x00c, larb4 +0x00c} and nothing else on those pages.
- Power: every window-12 access is within a block the AP has powered by then (VDE for <0x20000, VDE2 for >=0x20000); my recorder refused 0 accesses, mmio_bad=0 in every AU.
- For the fake patch (T02): my n2tr already models window 12 with per-page power and the larb handshake, so DEC02 needs no fake change; but DEC07s fake patch should mirror the larb4 allow-list too, and the handshake (bit0 -> bit16) is needed or the vendor burns 50000 reads per LOCK.

I will re-run against the real window as soon as it is in the tree (run.sh detects it and stops staging the V40 line).
